easyrmmAdditions: table row focus-within tint for j/k travel

themes.mechanism: class 'dark' on <html>; light is :root without it; choice stored in localStorage 'easyrmm.theme'

label.purpose: Form labels, key-value terms, stat labels, badges.

shadows.name: hairline
shadows.purpose: Cards, stat tiles, inputs, filled and secondary buttons.

shadows.name: drawer
shadows.purpose: Mobile sidebar drawer; the device tree over the page below lg.

shadows.name: input-focus
shadows.purpose: Input focus ring with accent border.

motion.name: toast-in
motion.value: 160ms ease-out, opacity 0 to 1 and translateY(8px) to 0

motion.name: dock-in
motion.value: 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), opacity 0 to 1 and translateX(12px) to 0

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: toast and dock animations none; all transitions 0ms

breakpoints.name: sm
breakpoints.purpose: Page padding 24px; first secondary columns shown; key-value two columns.

breakpoints.name: md
breakpoints.purpose: Stat tiles 4 across; more table columns.

breakpoints.name: lg
breakpoints.purpose: Sidebar docked; page padding 32px; remaining table columns.

breakpoints.name: xl
breakpoints.purpose: Card grids split into 2 or 3 columns.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main action of a page, form or dialog.
components.css: .ds-btn{font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; display:inline-flex; align-items:center; justify-content:center; gap:6px; height:34px; padding:0 14px; border-radius:6px; font-size:14px; font-weight:500; white-space:nowrap; cursor:pointer; transition:background-color .15s, color .15s;} .ds-btn-primary{background:var(--accent);color:var(--accent-fg);border:1px solid transparent;box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05);} .ds-btn-primary:hover{background:var(--accent-hover);} .ds-btn:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px;}

components.name: Secondary Button

components.name: Danger Button

components.name: Input
components.description: Shared text input and select; 34px minimum so toolbar fields align with buttons.
components.css: .ds-field{font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;} .ds-label{font-size:12px;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);} .ds-hint{font-size:12px;color:var(--subtle);} .ds-input{width:100%;min-height:2.125rem;border-radius:6px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:var(--fg);padding:6px 12px;font-size:14px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05);transition:border-color .15s;} .ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--subtle);} .ds-input:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 2px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent) 30%, transparent);}

components.name: Badge
components.description: Pill status label in six tones with soft fills.
components.html: Active MFA pending Locked Invited Disabled
components.css: .ds-badge{font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;border-radius:9999px;padding:2px 8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:500;white-space:nowrap;} .ds-ok{background:var(--ok-soft);color:var(--ok);} .ds-warn{background:var(--warn-soft);color:var(--warn);} .ds-danger{background:var(--danger-soft);color:var(--danger);} .ds-info{background:var(--info-soft);color:var(--info);} .ds-neutral{background:var(--neutral-soft);color:var(--muted);}

components.name: Card

components.css: .ds-card{font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--surface);color:var(--fg);box-shadow:0 1px 2px 0 rgb(0 0 0 / .05);} .ds-card-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:10px 16px;} .ds-card-head h2{margin:0;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;} .ds-card-head a{font-size:12px;color:var(--accent);text-decoration:none;} .ds-card-head a:hover{text-decoration:underline;} .ds-card-body{padding:16px;font-size:14px;}

components.name: Data Table
components.description: Uppercase muted head on raised; rows tint on hover and on focus-within for j/k travel.
components.css: .ds-table{font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif; width:100%;border-collapse:collapse;font-size:14px;color:var(--fg);background:var(--surface);} .ds-table th{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--raised);padding:8px 12px;text-align:left;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:.025em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted);white-space:nowrap;} .ds-table td{border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);padding:8px 12px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;} .ds-table tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0;} .ds-table tbody tr:hover,.ds-table tbody tr:focus-within{background:var(--hover);} .ds-table a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;} .ds-table a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--focus);outline-offset:2px;}

narrative.overview:
EasyRMM uses EasyPatch's design system, adopted as-is. This is the owner's binding instruction, recorded in ADR 0013 (`docs/architecture/adr/0013-easypatch-design-system.md`): a technician moving between the EasyPatch and EasyRMM consoles should not notice a change of product family. The upstream source of truth for every token is EasyPatch's `frontend/src/index.css`; `web/src/index.css` mirrors it value for value (verified by diff), and the primitives in `web/src/components/` follow EasyPatch's component vocabulary (same classes, variants, tones and states). Change a shared token in EasyPatch first, then mirror it here. Never fork a value locally.

The system is calm, dense and flat operator UI. Bordered surfaces on a dark canvas, one blue accent, four status tones with soft fills, a navy sidebar, the system UI font at a 14px base. Nothing decorative; every tile, badge and row is server data.

EasyRMM adds only five things on top of the shared system, all in service of keyboard travel and toolbar alignment: `kbd` styling, a uniform `.input` min-height so toolbar inputs and selects line up with buttons, a `focus-within` row tint for j/k travel, a `narrow` variant of KeyValueList, and `hideLegend` on AssignmentEditor. Everything else is EasyPatch's.
keyCharacteristics: EasyPatch's tokens, components and both themes, unchanged; EasyPatch `frontend/src/index.css` is upstream.
Dark theme by default, class-based (`<html class="dark">`), with a light theme toggle in the header.
Flat bordered surfaces; shadows are hairline (`shadow-xs`) at rest and only lift for overlays.
System UI stack, 14px base, tabular figures for counts.
Keyboard-first operation: j/k row travel with prefetch, "/" to search, live filter readouts.

rules.name: The Semantic Token Rule
rules.body: Components reference semantic tokens only (`surface`, `line`, `muted`, `danger-soft`), so both themes stay consistent. The only literal colors in shipped components are white text on the navy sidebar and on the danger button (with `#1a0606` danger-button text in dark).

rules.name: The Upstream Rule
rules.body: A token value changes in EasyPatch's `frontend/src/index.css` first and is mirrored here; EasyRMM does not diverge.

rules.name: The Tabular Count Rule
rules.body: Counts that sit in columns or tiles use tabular figures so they align.

rules.name: The Own-Height Rule
rules.body: Cards in a grid align to the top (`items-start`) and never stretch to match a neighbour.

rules.name: The Column Shedding Rule
rules.body: On narrow screens a table hides secondary columns by breakpoint; it never turns into a stack of cards.

rules.name: The Float-Only Lift Rule
rules.body: Only overlays (toast, drawer, dialog) get more than a hairline shadow.

dos: **Do** take every token from EasyPatch's `frontend/src/index.css`; mirror changes there first.
**Do** use semantic token classes (`bg-surface`, `text-muted`, `border-line`, tone `-soft` fills) so both themes hold.
**Do** keep dark as the default theme and toggle with the `dark` class on `<html>`.
**Do** keep cards in grids top-aligned with their own height (`items-start`).
**Do** hide secondary table columns below `sm`/`md`/`lg` rather than reflowing tables.
**Do** keep toolbar inputs, selects and medium buttons at the shared 34px height.
**Do** give list tables j/k row travel with prefetch, "/" search, and a live match readout when filtering.
**Do** show one-time secrets in a non-dismissible dialog with the one-time notice and a copy control.
**Do** require typing the object's name before a destructive delete.
**Do** use the product's nouns: organization, site, device group, device, technician.
**Do** show real API data only, with empty, loading, error, forbidden and read-only states.
donts: **Don't** fork a token value or add a local palette color in EasyRMM.
**Don't** load web fonts; the system UI stack is the face.
**Don't** put more than a hairline shadow on anything that is not an overlay.
**Don't** disable the sign-in button for empty fields; name the missing field instead.
**Don't** show placeholders, sample rows or fake data, and don't show a feature before it exists.
